messages:
maria: Quick note from postmortem review  We keep seeing remediations stall after the draft PM. I want to trial a "postmortem follow-up pulse" to tighten ownership and visibility: require owner ack within 48h, weekly 2-3 bullet pulse updates, auto-reminders at 7d and 30d, and escalation to manager at 45d. Thoughts?
sam: +1. Also recommend an explicit 'context owner' step: IC holds context for first 7 days, then either hands off or remains owner. Having the IC confirm reduces context loss.
leo: Strong +1. Add a 'blocked-by' column and a short risk score (L/M/H) in the tracker so PMs/sre can triage. We should also add an incident fingerprint tag so recurring patterns are easier to query.
dina: For comms cadence: weekly digest to #incidents (short list of active remediations), biweekly deep-dive at ops retro, monthly trends review with product and infra. Who volunteers to take the first digest?
irene: I can spin up a GitHub project board (ToDo/InProgress/Review/Done) and add issue templates + labels (risk, fingerprint, blocker). Ill hook a webhook into Slack for status changes.
maria: Nice. Proposed timeline template (draft):
Day 0: incident declared & IC assigned
Day 1 (24-48h): postmortem draft, remediation list, assign owners + deadlines; owners ACK within 48h
Day 7: pulse update 1 (owner posts 2-3 bullets in thread)
Day 14: pulse update 2 (owner)
Day 30: remediation status review & reprioritization
Day 45: escalation to manager if still open/unblocked
sam: Can we formalize the 15m handoff meeting within 5 days when IC hands off work? Put that in the template too. Also add 'owner acknowledges scope' line.
leo: Agree. I'll add fingerprint tagging guidance (short machine-friendly slug) to link remediations across incidents. Example: kv-cache-eviction-regression.
dina: Weekly digest format proposal: IncidentID + short title, Owner + ETA, Blockers, Risk (L/M/H), Link to issue/PR. Keep it <=8 items. Also include an overall "top risk" item.
irene: Plan: create GH board + webhook + issue template by Friday. I'll post setup instructions and sample issues here.
maria: Action owners for next steps: irene -> GH board + webhook + templates by Fri COB; sam -> add 'owner ack' and 15m handoff to postmortem template by Tue; leo -> prepare sample weekly digest and post in #incidents next Wed; dina -> schedule biweekly retro deep-dive and monthly trend slot.
irene: ACK. Will comment here with the board link when ready.
sam: ACK. Will update templates and ping #devex.
leo: ACK. Will include fingerprint examples.
oncall-bot: [automation] Created project board: https://github.com/redwood-inference/incident-remediations (private)
maria: Thanks everyone. We'll have a short sync in #eng-oncall next Thu at 10:00 to review the board and sample digest. After we validate the flow, we'll update the postmortem README and make this the standard follow-up process. :thumbsup:
